export.closeTooltip: Close the publication figure export composer without exporting.
export.previewHelpPre: Drag a panel to move it; drag a corner/edge handle to resize. Shift-click to select several. Per-panel
export.previewHelpPost: (in the inspector) keeps a panel from being stretched.
export.previewOverlayTooltip: Drag panels to move, drag handles to resize, Shift-click to multi-select.
export.resizeHandleTooltip: Drag to resize the selected panel.

toolbar.addPanelTooltip: Add a pattern panel (Experimental / Simulated / NCC / map) to the figure.
toolbar.addTextTooltip: Add an editable free-text caption element to the figure.
toolbar.addRNccTooltip: Insert an R/NCC caption text element
toolbar.addScaleBarTooltip: Add a scale bar; auto-fits to micrometres when map step size is known.
toolbar.addColorbarTooltip: Add an NCC colour ramp legend to the figure.
toolbar.backgroundTooltip: Set the figure background: white, black, transparent, or custom colour.
toolbar.customColorTooltip: Pick a custom background colour for the figure.
toolbar.copyTooltip: Copy the figure to the clipboard

align.title: Align / distribute ({{count}})
align.alignTooltip: Align selected elements: left, h-center, right, top, v-center, bottom.
align.distributeTooltip: Evenly distribute 3+ selected elements along X or Y.
align.sameSizeTooltip: Match selected elements to the first one's width or height.

presets.title: Layout presets
presets.nameTooltip: Type a name to save the current layout as a reusable preset.
presets.saveTooltip: Save the current figure layout under the entered preset name.
presets.loadTooltip: Load a previously saved figure layout preset.
presets.deleteTooltip: Delete a saved figure layout preset.

resolution.title: Resolution & format
resolution.modeTooltip: Choose export sizing: by scale factor or by fixed width in pixels.
resolution.scaleTooltip: Set the export resolution as a multiple of the base canvas size.
resolution.widthTooltip: Set the exact export width in pixels (height follows aspect).
resolution.formatTooltip: Choose the export image format: lossless PNG or compressed JPEG.
resolution.jpegQualityTooltip: Set JPEG compression quality from 0.5 to 1.0.
resolution.exportTooltip: Render the composed figure and download it as PNG/JPEG.

inspector.empty: Select an element to edit it. Add panels / text / scale bar / colorbar from the toolbar.
inspector.removeTooltip: Delete the selected element from the figure.
inspector.borderTooltip: Draw a coloured border around the selected panel.
inspector.borderWidthTooltip: Set the panel border thickness in pixels (1–20).
inspector.caption: Caption
inspector.captionTooltip: Show and edit a caption label beneath the selected panel.
inspector.captionTextTooltip: Edit the caption text shown beneath the selected panel.
inspector.letterTooltip: Show a sub-figure letter on the panel; choose (a) / a) / A style.
inspector.markersTooltip: Burn the numbered point markers into this panel on export.
inspector.aspectLockTooltip: Lock the panel aspect ratio so the pattern is not stretched.
inspector.samplingTooltip: Pixel sampling: Upscaled (crisp, nearest) or Native (smooth, bilinear).
inspector.textTooltip: Edit the text shown by the selected caption element.
inspector.sizeTooltip: Set the font size of the selected text element.
inspector.colorTooltip: Pick the colour of the selected element (border / text / scale bar).
inspector.visibleTooltip: Show or hide the NCC colorbar in the figure.
inspector.minMaxTooltip: Set the colorbar value range (min and max ends of the ramp).
inspector.lengthTooltip: Set the scale bar length in its physical unit (µm or px).

linked.imageTooltip: Hover for a linked crosshair; click to drop or remove a numbered marker.
